text:
One day I went exploring in my backyard. It was a beautiful sunny day for seeing nature. I chose to go near the big oak tree. Suddenly, a blue bird appeared and flew very fast. It landed on a branch and looked at me. It was guarding a small nest. Then my dog Sparky ran over barking.

"Be quiet Sparky!" I yelled loudly. "You are scaring the bird."

The bird flew away because it was scared. I saw a squirrel sleeping on the grass nearby. Sparky stole a stick and ran around fast. He threw the stick in the air with his mouth. His tongue was hanging out and he looked funny. I wanted to maintain a secret spot. I pretended I was invisible so the animals stayed close. It was certain to be the best day ever.

My friend Max and I wanted a big adventure. We trained for weeks in my backyard. We packed snacks and flashlights. Max grinned and said, "We are ready for anything!"

We walked a league into the dark woods. Suddenly, we heard a loud noise. Something crashed in the bushes nearby! It sounded like a foreign monster. My eyes closed tight because I was scared. Max was brave enough to look.

A small alien greeted us with a beep. It was not scary at all! Max looked at me and laughed. "It is impossible that aliens are real!" he shouted. We did not know what to do next. We decided to take him home for dinner.

It was almost my birthday in February. My best friend Sam came over for a sleepover adventure. We jumped on my bed and scratched my dog’s ears. Suddenly my mom came in and she looked mad. 

"Who moved my favorite comb?" she asked us.

"We didn't touch it!" Sam shouted while keeping his fingers crossed. 

We neared the kitchen and I smelled something bad. It smelled like scorched popcorn! My dad was swearing because he burned our snack. 

"I think I’m getting pneumonia from this smoke," I joked.

Then my mom found her comb under the couch. We started cheering because we were not in trouble. We ate the burnt popcorn anyway and stayed up super late. It was the best night ever.

It was my birthday last Wednesday and I turned eight. My mom made a big chocolate cake for everyone to eat. We had the party in the backyard with my friends. We played tag and then we wanted to eat the cake. But when we went to the table, the cake was gone!

"Where did the cake go?" asked my friend Sam.

We searched under the table and behind the chairs. Then I realized my dog Buster had chocolate on his nose. He was supposed to guard the cake but he ate it! It was impossible to be mad at him because he looked funny.

"Bad dog, Buster!" I said, but I laughed anyway.

My dad went to the store and got ice cream instead. We seized the spoons and ate it all very fast. It was the best birthday ever.

Me and my neighbor Sam went exploring in the woods. We saw a big tree and Sam started jumping up. He grabbed a branch and was clinging on tight. Suddenly the branch shook and cracked!

"Help! I can't hold my own weight!" Sam called loudly.

I sprinted over and used all my strength to grab him. I pushed him up before he fell. It was really dangerous because the ground had sharp rocks.

"Thanks for saving me," Sam said. "I don't want pneumonia from lying on the cold ground."

We met a squirrel on the way home. It looked like it was dancing on the green ceiling of leaves. We decided to go back tomorrow but stay on the ground.

I was climbing the big oak tree in my backyard. I reached a high branch and looked at the ground. It looked so far away! Suddenly, I saw a squirrel sitting there. He chewed on a tiny crumb of bread.

"Hello little squirrel," I whispered to him.

He looked at me and didn't run away. This was incredible! I slowly broke off a piece of my sandwich. I held it out with my thumb and finger. The squirrel came closer gradually. He took the food and looked very pleased. I felt like I was bungee jumping inside because I was so excited.

"You are my best friend now," I said.

I especially liked his fluffy tail. We sat there until a storm brewed in the sky. Then I climbed down fast. It was the best day ever.

Me and my brother Max went camping in the big woods. We wanted to find treasure in the green meadow. Max was jumping over logs and I ran fast. Suddenly, we found a big rock that looked scorched by fire.

"Look at that scary black rock!" I screamed.

Max turned around and looked at the ground. There was a big snake near the rock.

"Watch out for danger!" Max screamed.

We ran back to our tent very fast. We hung our wet coats on a tree. It was important to be safe. We didn't find treasure, but we saw a cool snake. Next time we will bring a stick. Exploring is fun but sometimes scary.

We were playing the biggest kickball game ever at recess. My team had eight points and the other team had seven. It was my turn to kick and I was super nervous.

"You can do it, Tommy!" my friend Sam shouted loudly.

The pitcher neared the mound and looked very mean. He threw the red ball fast and it bounced high. I jumped up and kicked it with all my might. The ball went over the fence near the nature trail!

"Run, run, run!" everyone yelled at me.

I ran past first base and stuck my tongue out. I closed my eyes and ran to home plate. We won the game and everyone shook my hand. I felt like I climbed a giant mountain. I put the winning ball in my pocket like a receipt.

I was so thrilled about my new pet beetle. His name is Bob and he is very shiny. I brought him to school in a glass jar. I knew it was risky but I wanted to show Tim. At recess, I took Bob out on the grass. He crawled fast.

"Look at him go!" Tim yelled.

Suddenly, a big dog ran onto the playground. It was not trained very well. The dog sniffed Bob and then gave a huge sneeze. Bob flew into the air! I was scared the dog would eat him.

"Oh no!" I shouted. "Grab him, Tim!"

The dog chewed on a stick instead. We found Bob near the slide. My teacher came over early and looked mad. She heard someone swearing near the swings, but it wasn't us. We put Bob back in the jar safe and sound.

Me and my neighbor Tim went to the jungle behind my house. We were looking for the lost magic jewel. It was very important. Suddenly we saw a big snake in a tree. It looked like danger! I was so scared. The snake started jumping down at us.

"Run away fast!" yelled Tim.

We ran but the snake was fast. I threw a rock at it. The rock hit the tree and made a loud noise. It was a crazy scene. We found a cave and hid inside.

"Listen, do you hear that?" I asked Tim.

We heard hissing outside. We used a big leaf to wrap up our snacks. Then we escaped out the back. We ran home and told Tim’s daughter about our adventure. It was past eight o'clock so we had to sleep.

I went to the fair with my best friend Sam. We ran through the gate and saw all the rides. The big roller coaster was scary but we wanted to go. We were approaching the line and it was super long.

"Are you scared?" Sam asked me while we waited.

"No way, I love gravity!" I said back to him.

We were loading into the car and the bar came down. The car went up gradually and the scenery looked tiny. Then we dropped down fast and everyone was screaming! The wind struck my face and we were swinging around corners. It felt like we were flying but much faster. We got off and my legs were shaking a little. I want to go on it for longer next time!

It was freezing outside but we didn't care. My soccer team ran straight onto the field. We played against the Tigers and they looked tough. Their uniforms were blue like a shiny jewel.

"Pass the ball to me!" my friend Sam yelled.

I kicked it but the goalie stopped it. It seemed impossible to score. Gradually we got closer to the goal though. I saw a beautiful opening. I used my brain and kicked it hard. The ball went past the goalie and hit the net!

"We won the game!" everyone shouted while cheering.

Our coach greeted us with snacks near the water fountain. It was a complete victory. We drew pictures of the game later. It was the best day ever.

It was a pleasant Tuesday and school was okay. I had eight problems to do for math homework. My friend Tommy was roaming around the room. He grabbed a piece of red thread from the art bin.

"Look at this," Tommy said and held it up. "It looks like a long worm."

I laughed because Tommy is always weird. The teacher said to sit down so we did. Then it was time for recess outside. We played tag and I was the greatest runner. I knew I was fast. Then I saw something shiny in the grass. It was a fake jewel from a plastic crown.

"Can I keep it?" asked Sarah.

I gave it to her and we ran back inside. It was a good day.

Me and my best friend Sam went into the dark woods. We walked for an hour and then we saw a big cave. It looked scary but we moved closer to peek inside.

Suddenly we heard a loud moaning sound coming from the dark.

"I think we should run away now!" yelled Sam loudly.

"No, we have to seize the treasure first," I said back.

We remembered the map and looked at the compass needle. It pointed straight so we kept walking for eight more steps. We saw a glowing box keeping guard by a sleeping dragon! The dragon had a long tongue hanging out. We were quiet like our teacher was coaching us. We grabbed the box and ran fast to our treehouse. We often go on adventures but this was the best one in the whole league!

Max and I went into the dark woods to search for treasure. We had a map but the rain almost crushed it.

"We have to complete the quest!" shouted Max loudly.

We pushed through the big bushes and saw a huge cave. It looked impossible to climb but we tried anyway. I remembered my dad said to be brave. We climbed up the rocks and found a gold box waiting there.

Suddenly a bear roared and we got scared. We sprinted back home very fast.

"We can try again tomorrow," I said to Max.

We are earning money for a new bike. It was the best adventure ever.

One day me and my friend Sam went boating. We were looking for pirate gold on the island. I was steering the boat and Sam was looking. Suddenly we hit the rocky ground hard.

"Oh no, the boat is broken!" shouted Sam.

We jumped out and started running fast. We were hungry though so we ate some apples. We kept walking and gradually got closer to a cave. It was dark inside and we heard a sounding noise.

"Is that a bear approaching?" I asked scared.

It was just a tiny bat meeting its friends. We found the gold and ran back home. Everyone was happy we were safe and not in the hospital.

My birthday started weird from the very beginning. I thought my mom brewed hot chocolate, but it was just coffee. I hate coffee! Then my dog Buster tried to gnaw on my new shoe.

"Stop it, Buster!" I yelled at him.

He dropped the shoe and wagged his tail fast. My best friend Sam came over later for a sleepover. We drew pictures of monsters and ate pizza.

"Let's seize the castle!" Sam shouted and jumped on my bed.

We played until we were super tired. To be honest, it was the best day ever. I can't wait for tomorrow because we are going to the park. I am glad this happened.

My friends and I went into the spooky old house. We saw a big painting of a sailor on the wall. The sailor looked sad and he was holding a map. Suddenly, we heard a loud noise upstairs.

"Did you hear that?" shouted Ben.

"I think it is a ghost!" I whispered back.

We walked up the stairs slowly and kept following the noise. We went into a room and a vase crashed down. A cat jumped out and landed on my foot! It wasn't a ghost though. We found an old box that belonged to a colonel.

"Look at this wonderful treasure," Ben said.

We opened it and saw gold coins inside. Gradually we realized the meaning of the map. It was teaching us where to find the secret league of pirates. We used a blanket to wrap up the gold and ran home fast.

I sat at my desk and looked at the schedule. It was time for lunch and I was so hungry. I grabbed my bag and flew down the hall. I sat next to my best friend Sam. He had a weird stain on his shirt.

"What is that orange spot?" I asked him.

"I dropped my juice box," Sam said sadly.

I opened my lunchbox but my sandwich was gone. I knew I packed it this morning. I started to search through my bag. My chips were scattered everywhere. Then I saw a giant beetle near my apple! I screamed and jumped up to my full height. The beetle crawled away fast. I thought someone took my food, but it was just hidden. I am keeping my lunchbox closed tight tomorrow.

It was a beautiful day for recess and everyone ran outside. The weather was hot but we didn't care. I was the captain of the tag team. We had thirteen kids playing and it was super fun. Then Tommy started climbing the big red slide the wrong way.

"Hey, get down from there!" I yelled at him.

Tommy didn't listen and he looked a little scared. He scratched his arm on the metal part. Then the bell rang for science class. We learned about a baby lamb and it was cute. I didn't know enough answers on the quiz though. After school, I watched a video about bungee jumping. I am certain that I want to try it when I turn fourteen.

My birthday party was on Saturday and everyone came over. I wanted to receive a cool video game for my present. My grandma handed me a big box and I smiled. I opened it fast but I was wearing a frown. It was a brown leather jacket and it looked very old.

"Do you like it?" Grandma asked me with a smile.

"I love it!" I lied because I did not want anger.

I pulled it on but neither arm fit in the sleeves. Suddenly my brother screamed because he saw a bug on it. I feared it was a spider but it was just fuzz. My mom got a knife to cut the tag off. I wished for a game but got clothes instead. It is stronger than my old coat so I wear it often.

I was dreaming about a magic forest. But my dog Rex licked my thumb and I woke up. It was a sunny Saturday morning.

"Come on Rex, let's go outside," I said.

We ran to the park and I saw a big tree. It looked like a castle made of leaves. Rex sprinted to the tree and barked. I reached up and grabbed a low branch.

"Look, a squirrel is hiding there!" I shouted.

The squirrel jumped away instead of staying. We played tag in the grass until I was tired. It was a wonderful day. We walked home and I closed my eyes. This was just the beginning of our fun weekend.

My schedule said it was time for recess. I started running to the playground leading the whole class. We wanted to search for the best swing. As we neared the swings, I heard loud thumping. It was big Jake running fast behind us!

"Hey, save a swing for me!" Jake shouted.

I screamed because he was getting really close. We were bumping into each other and scrambled to the seats. I got there first and sat down fast. The bell rang way too soon. We were leaving the playground sad but I won the race.

"Next time I will be faster," Jake said.

School is fun but recess is too short.

It was my birthday and I was yearning for a puppy. We live in a small apartment so my mom said no dogs allowed. I felt sad but then my neighbor knocked on the door. He was stamping his feet because it was cold outside. "Happy birthday!" he shouted and was cheering loudly. My mom opened the door and a cool breeze came in. He was holding a leash with a chain on it. I got scared but then I saw the scenery behind him. A tiny dog was bumping into his leg. "This is Captain," my neighbor said. "He needs a friend." I wanted to seize the leash right away. I am the happiest boy on earth.

I was in my room doing a science experiment. I wanted to build a robot but it went wrong. My robot had scissors for hands and a chain for a tail. I brewed a green potion and poured it on him. Suddenly the robot blew smoke out of his ears! He stood up and looked very scary. I was scared but then he started to dance.

"Do you want to play?" asked the robot.

"Yes please!" I yelled and we danced together.

My mom came in and she thought it was a costume.

"What a cool knight suit," she said.

The robot beeped happy sounds and we were best friends forever.

It was my birthday and I was so happy. I walked into the kitchen and saw my friends. They greeted me with a big loud shout. My mom had balloons surrounding the whole table.

"Happy Birthday, Tim!" screamed my best friend Max.

We ate pizza and then my dog started roaming around. He grabbed a slice and chewed it fast. Mom was moaning about the mess but she laughed too. Then it was time for the cake. I blew out the candles and made a wish.

"Can I cut the cake?" asked my sister.

She used the scissors by mistake but we stopped her. A piece of cake landed on my new blue sweater. I was pleased anyway because it tasted really good. We played games throughout the whole afternoon.

My brother Tom and I found a secret cave. We walked inside and it grew very dark. Tom grabbed his flashlight and I followed him deep down. Suddenly a big wind blew my hat off!

"It is impossible to see in here!" I yelled.

We saw a giant metal door with a weird computer on it. Tom started coaching me on how to open it. I typed in fourteen numbers and the door opened. Inside was a huge dragon that looked angry! It roared and fire struck the wall near us. We smelled roasted marshmallows but we were scared.

"Start running or we will be eaten!" Tom screamed.

We ran back to the steering wheel of our go-kart. We crossed the bridge and escaped the dragon's reign forever. We were not screaming anymore, but we were safe. We didn't want to go back there either.

I was playing my favorite computer game on Saturday. It was the biggest game of the whole league. My best friend Sam was on my team. We were surrounding the bad guys base. Suddenly my screen froze and I got scared. 

"Oh no, my game is broken!" I screeched loudly. 

Sam yelled back, "Don't quit now, we need you!"

I hit the side of the computer and it worked. I sent my character running fast toward the goal. I felt a huge weight off my shoulders. I crashed right into the enemy king. We won the game and I was so thrilled throughout the day. I even scratched my head because I was so surprised. It was the most important win ever.

It was raining outside so we had indoor recess. I looked at my sandwich and saw a big jelly stain. I simply ate the crust instead. My friend Sarah bounced a ball near my desk.

"Hey, watch out for my project!" I yelled.

"Sorry, I thought you were done," Sarah said.

I was building a huge castle with blocks. It was growing very tall. I believed it was the best castle ever. Then our teacher Mrs. Green started coaching us on math. We had to complete a worksheet. She treated us to stickers when we finished. I grinned because I got a sticker with a fluffy lamb on it. School is fun but I like recess better.

My family went boating to a small island for my birthday. I wore my favorite blue sweater because it was cold. My dad told me to help set up the tent. We spread out the sleeping bags and looked for firewood.

"Can we roast the marshmallows now?" I asked my mom.

"First we need to find some dry sticks," she said.

We went on a search for sticks near the water. I saw something floating and I crawled over to see it. It was just an old piece of leather. Later, my dad taught me how to cook a lamb chop on the fire. I scorched it a little bit but it still tasted good. Then my sister used scissors to open the marshmallow bag. We ate them all night under the stars. It was the best birthday ever!

My family went on a holiday to a big park. We saw a huge mountain covered in white snow. My dad said we needed training to climb it.

"I bet I can climb that mountain!" I shouted.

"We don't have enough rope," said my mom.

The weather was sunny but the wind was stinging my face. We walked on a trail and looked at the scenery. Suddenly my brother threw a snowball right at my back! I chased him and I almost won the race. We saw a place where people did bungee jumping. I feared looking down but it looked fun too. We ate sandwiches and then we drove home tired.

Me and my nephew Jack went to the spooky forest today. We were looking for pirate gold. I had an old leather map, and Jack had a flashlight.

"This is scary," Jack grumbled.

"Don't worry, Colonel Jack," I said. "We are brave."

We walked straight for a long time. Suddenly, I discovered a big hole. It was lit by glowing mushrooms. We dropped a stone in, but we heard nothing. Then a giant rat chewed on my shoe!

"Run!" I yelled.

I was steering us away, but I tripped on a root. A sharp needle from a pine tree poked me. We ran home fast. We understood the reason pirates hide gold there. It is too dangerous!

It was raining outside so we rode our bikes to the arcade. My best friend Sam wanted to win a special jewel in the claw game. I was certain he would lose because claw games are hard. He put his quarter in carefully and we started breathing fast.

"Move it left!" I yelled. "Just squeeze the button now!"

Sam pushed the button and the claw dropped down. It was trembling as it grabbed the prize. We watched the claw pull up the blue jewel. Then it moved over the hole and started dumping the prize out. We were thrilled when we found it in the slot! We simply couldn't believe it.

"I am going to call the newspaper!" Sam said.

We walked home happy. It was like pulling a thread and winning the whole shirt.

My friends and I built a secret fort in the woods. It was dark and we heard a scary moaning sound.

"What is that noise?" asked my friend Billy.

I was not certain but I was very brave. We followed the sound past the old colonel’s house. Suddenly something came swinging out of the trees! It was a stinging bee and it chased us. My tongue felt dry and my legs grew tired.

"Run back to the fort!" yelled Sarah loudly.

We ran fast and closed the door tight. We ate toasted bread and looked at a painting on the wall. Billy said he needed caffeine but he just drank juice. We were safe inside our fort.

I was sitting in class and it was boring. Mrs. Miller was speaking about math but I didn't listen. I drew a picture of a sailor on my paper. Suddenly my pencil disappeared under my desk! I was afraid to look but I did.

"Hey, give that back!" I said.

My friend Tommy grabbed it and laughed. We fought over the pencil until Mrs. Miller saw us. She froze and looked very mad.

"Who is making that screaming noise?" she asked us.

It wasn't pleasant. I did not receive a gold star that day. Then lunch happened and gravity made my milk spill everywhere. I didn't use scissors for art either. It was a bad day. Next time I will just do my work.

It was the greatest Wednesday ever because we had gym. We played rock paper scissors but it was a race. My heart was pumping super fast when it was my turn. I ran to the middle and met Tommy there.

"Rock paper scissors shoot!" I yelled really loud.

I picked rock and Tommy picked scissors so I won. I was jumping up and down because I was so happy. Then I ran to the next hoop and crossed the line. But then I tripped and crawled to the finish. I grabbed the beanbag first so my team won the game. After school I went home and ate some roasted chicken. It was the best day.

My brother Tim turned eight today. It was raining outside, but we didn't care. We played pirate ship in the living room. Tim was the captain and I was the sailor. We crashed our ship into the sofa island.

"Be careful or you will get in trouble!" Mom yelled.

We stopped jumping, but we were already having fun. Mom made a cake that tasted like heaven. It had blue frosting like a giant vein of sugar.

"This is the most important day ever," Tim said.

Even though we couldn't go outside, it was a great party. We reached for more cake and watched a movie. I know Tim liked his present especially because it was a new bike. I hope the rain stops so he can ride it tomorrow.

My dog Max and I went exploring in the woods today. We heard something moving in the bushes.

"What is that?" I whispered to Max.

Max started stamping his feet and twisted his head sideways. A squirrel ran up a tree with a nut. It looked like a shiny brown jewel.

"Let's catch it!" I yelled and we ran fast.

We found a big rock with a blue line like a vein. It looked like a map so I drew on it. We pretended we were in a foreign land. Suddenly we heard footsteps approaching us. It was just my dad greeting us.

"Are you yearning for dinner?" Dad asked.

We smelled roasted chicken and our stomachs growled. We ran home feeling our strength growing. I like exploring but I like eating more.

It was my birthday and I woke up super early. The sun was coming through my window and it was bright. I ran downstairs and saw my mom in the kitchen. She cleared the table and put down a big box.

"Is this for me?" I asked with a happy feeling.

"Open it and see," she said with a smile.

I ripped the paper and touched something soft inside. It was a new puppy! He was small but he had a lot of strength. He jumped right out and ran outside into the breeze. I thought he was running away! But he just wanted to play tag. We played all day until I was tired. Best birthday ever.

I went to the jungle with my friend Sam. We called it the Green Zone. We walked through big trees and tall grass. Suddenly we saw a monkey jumping high.

"Look at him swinging!" yelled Sam.

The monkey grabbed a thin thread from a spider. I feared it would break. Then a big tiger jumped out. I pulled out my plastic knife toy. The tiger crashed into a bush and ran away. We were safe.

"That was scary but cool," I said.

We found a treasure chest behind a rock. It looked like an old computer box. To be honest, it was just empty. But we still felt like we won the game.

We were walking in the dark forest for a long time. My friend Sam had a map but the weather was bad. It was raining hard and the map got wet.

"Which way do we go now?" asked Sam.

I looked at the scary trees surrounding us. We chose the path on the right. Suddenly a giant bear jumped out! I screamed very loud and Sam threw a rock. The bear tried to gnaw on my shoe but I pulled it away. I drew my wooden sword quickly because I trained for this. The bear crushed a bush and ran at us.

"Run away fast!" I yelled to Sam.

We escaped into a small cave and the bear disappeared. We ate a crumb of bread and felt safe. We won the fight and we will learn to be more careful next time.

I woke up early because I was so afraid of school today. We had a big test about a special island and I did not study enough. My heart was thumping hard in my chest. I ate my toast and chewed really fast. Then I walked straight to the bus stop.

When the bus neared the school, I saw my friend Sam. He was holding a crumpled newspaper for show-and-tell.

"Did you study for the test?" I asked him.

"No way, I was playing video games all night," Sam said.

We walked past the crossing guard and into the class. I was pumping my legs fast to get to my desk. The teacher looked at us and smiled. She said the test was next week! I was so happy. Now I can just play at recess.

I was hanging upside down on the monkey bars at recess. The sun was hot and I felt like a piece of toasted bread. My friend Billy ran over to me and he looked scared. He was trembling a little bit.

"You need to come down right now," Billy said fast.

"Why is it dangerous?" I asked him.

Billy pointed to the school door. Mrs. Green was standing there with a red face. I felt a little bit of anger coming from her. I knew I was caught. I didn't finish my math homework and she looked mad.

"Oh no," I said, groaning loudly.

I jumped down and we walked to the door. It was no pleasure to see the teacher. She spoke to me with a serious voice.

"I don't understand where your homework is," she said.

It struck me that I left it on the bus. I met her eyes and said sorry. It was a bad day.

One day I was walking in the big woods. My dog Buster was with me and he loves sniffing. Suddenly a big buzzing sound appeared near a bush. Buster ran over to see but I felt scared.

"Stop Buster!" I yelled really loud. "There is danger!"

It was a giant hive of bees and they looked mad. Buster barked at them and I knew this was important. I reached for his collar and pulled him back fast. We ran away before any stinging happened. We escaped just in time and ran all the way home.

"That was incredible," I said to Buster.

He just wagged his tail and licked my face. We are safe now but we won't go back there.

Yesterday my dad drove me to school late. We were waiting in the car line forever. My heart was thumping hard because I forgot my homework. I chewed on my pencil and felt weird.

I walked into class and Mrs. Green was reading a newspaper. She said, "Where is your math, Jimmy?"

I tried to squeeze my eyes shut. "I didn't write it," I said quietly.

Then my nose tickled and I let out a giant sneeze! Mrs. Green laughed and gave me a tissue. She told me to write it at recess. It was okay though because I played on the swings after. I held the rusty chain and went super high. Next week we are going camping so I need to know my math fast.

My dog Buster chased a squirrel up the big oak tree. He barked and barked but the squirrel was too fast. Then Buster saw something shiny in the bushes. It was a giant green beetle with long legs.

"Look out Buster!" I yelled.

Buster tried to catch it but he crashed into the fence. The beetle flew away and escaped into the tall grass. Buster started stamping his feet because he was mad. It was impossible to catch that bug.

Suddenly, my cat Fluffy jumped out and trapped the beetle. She screeched happily and I started cheering for her.

"Good job Fluffy," I said.

We played outside until the sun went down. It was the best day ever.

One day I was walking near a big mountain. Suddenly the ground started shaking and sounding like thunder. I saw a giant robot stamping his metal feet. He was bringing a huge bag of space rocks. It was an incredible sight to see.

"Hello robot!" I yelled loudly at him.

The robot stopped and looked down at me. "I am very hungry for oil," he beeped.

I gave him my oil can from my bike. He drank everything inside and started bumping around happily. He was gradually turning a pleasant shade of blue.

"Thank you for understanding the meaning of friendship," he said.

Then he flew away without seeing where he was going. I hope he comes back soon.

We were yearning for an adventure. My friend Leo and I started loading our backpacks with snacks. We walked to the big mountain behind my house. It was scary but we bounced with excitement. We saw a dark cave approaching fast.

"Should we go in?" asked Leo.

"Yes, maybe there is gold!" I said.

Inside it was cold. We touched the wet walls. Suddenly we saw a rusty chain on the ground. It looked very old. We pulled the chain and a secret door opened! We found a shiny rock inside. It felt like earning a big prize. We ran home fast to show my mom.

Yesterday at school was super fun but also a little weird. We had a contest to see who could jump the highest height. I wanted to win, but unfortunately, my legs felt like heavy weights. 

My friend Sam grinned at me and said, "You can do it!"

I tried really hard, and gradually I jumped a little bit longer. I didn't win, but I still felt happy. Later at lunch, I found a single cookie in my box. I had to wrap it up fast before Sam saw it.

"Is that a chocolate chip cookie?" Sam asked me loudly.

I nodded and shared half with him like we were on a desert island. It was the best lunch ever.

My younger brother Sam was in big trouble. We looked inside the scary cave and heard a noise. I told him to remain quiet but he never listens. Suddenly, a giant bear walked out and it looked angry! It roared loudly and Sam tried to explain.

"We just want our ball back, Mr. Bear!" he shouted.

The bear did not like speaking so it roared again with anger. I grabbed Sam's arm and we ran fast instead. We were the greatest runners in the world that day. We didn't get the ball, but at least we got away safely!
